description: Read, configure, invoke, or kill unattended recovery for a saved contract. Recovery automatically accepts and resumes the pipeline only when every blocking machine check of the saved contract passes; otherwise it waits for buyer approval. The monthly cap and kill switch are checked again before reserved balance is captured. read: GET /v1/contracts/{id}/recover. configure: PUT /v1/contracts/{id}/recover; body: enabled, monthly_cap_usd, callback_url. recover: POST /v1/contracts/{id}/recover; body: failed_input, budget_usd, idempotency_key. kill: DELETE /v1/contracts/{id}/recover. failed_input: GET /v1/bounties/{id}/recovery-input.
